खिलः --लं [खिल्-क]
1 A piece
of waste or uncultivated land,
desert or bare soil; a desert, waste.
--2 A gap, vacant place.
--3 An
additional hymn appended to the
regular collection;

.
--4 A supplement in general.
--5 A
compendium, compilation.
--6 Vacuity.
--7 Remainder.
--लः N. of Brahmā
and of Viṣṇu. [खिल is often used in
combination with भू and कृ; (1) खिलीभू
(a) to become impassable, to be
blocked up, be left unfrequented;
खिलीभूते विमानानां तदापातभयात्पथि

. (b) to lay
waste, devastate, put down or
vanquish completely; विपक्षमखिलीकृत्य
प्रतिष्ठा खलु दुर्लभा Śi. 2. 34.]
